prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Houston after a car wreck. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
Below are several reputable Houston-area personal injury firms you can call after a car wreck, plus why each is worth contacting. Call a few and compare — different firms fit different cases and budgets.

Recommended firms to call (and why)
- Arnold & Itkin LLP — Houston-based, strong trial reputation in catastrophic injury and wrongful-death cases; they’re experienced handling complex liability and high-value car wreck claims.
- The Lanier Law Firm (Mark Lanier) — national, trial-focused plaintiff firm with experience obtaining large verdicts and settlements in serious auto cases.
- Susman Godfrey LLP — Houston-headquartered boutique trial firm known for taking big, complex plaintiff cases to trial; good if your claim is high-value or legally complicated.
- Morgan & Morgan (Houston office) — large national plaintiff firm with local resources; they handle high volumes of auto cases and have staff to manage medical liens and insurance negotiations quickly.
- The Cochran Firm Texas (Houston) — Texas presence of a well-known plaintiff firm with experience in serious personal injury and auto accident work.

Why call several firms
- Experience and trial ability: You want lawyers who will negotiate with insurers but will also take a case to trial if needed.
- Resources: Some firms have teams to manage medical records, liens and experts; others are smaller and more boutique.
- Fit and communication: You’ll want someone who communicates clearly, returns calls, and explains fees and strategy.
- Contingency fee structure: Most PI firms work on contingency (no fee unless you recover). Compare percentages and cost advances.

What to ask on the initial call
- Do you handle car-accident/personal-injury cases in Houston? (Ask about cases similar to yours.)
- What’s your contingency fee and how are costs handled if we don’t win?
- Have you handled (or tried) cases against the at-fault driver’s insurer and in our county’s courts?
- Who on your team will handle day-to-day communication?
- Do you handle medical liens and coordinate with medical providers?
- Do you think my case needs litigation or can it be negotiated?

Documents to have ready for the consultation
- Police report number (or copy)
- Photos of the crash, vehicle damage, injuries, scene
- Names/contact of other drivers, witnesses, and insurance information
- Medical records or at least dates of treatment and providers
- Pay stubs (if lost wages are involved)
- Any correspondence from insurers

Quick practical points
- Statute of limitations in Texas for most personal-injury claims is two years from the crash date — call promptly. (Exceptions may apply.)
- Seek medical care immediately and follow treatment; gaps can hurt your claim.
- Don’t give recorded statements to insurers without your lawyer.
- Call at least 3 firms and compare answers on fees, likely value, and strategy.

Sample script for your call
“Hi — I was in a car crash on [date] in [area of Houston]. I was injured and treated at [hospital/clinic]. I want to know if you take injury cases like mine on contingency and whether you can review my files. Can I schedule a free consultation?”

If you want, tell me the date/location of the crash, severity of injuries, whether the police report indicates fault, and whether you’ve been contacted by insurance — I can help prioritize which of these firms or types of firms would likely be best for your situation and suggest specific questions tailored to your facts.
